blurb: The Crystal River Outfitters Recreational District has been a destination for anyone driving the M22 scenic highway in search of adventure for over 25 years. Just 26 miles from Traverse City, we are in the unique position to offer unforgettable kayak and canoe trips in the Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore.
